  1. dataAnalysis

Uses of Package
dataAnalysis

Packages that use dataAnalysis
Package
Description
NodeSections
Node sections, the building blocks from which the JSIM simulation engine stations are composed.
QueueNet
Queueing network model of the JSIM simulation engine: nodes, stations, jobs, job classes, measures and the global structures that connect them.
common.definitions
Definition of the JMT simulation model data structure (CommonModel, StationDefinition, ClassDefinition, ...) shared by JSIMgraph and JSIMwiz.
dataAnalysis
Output analysis of JSIM simulation results.
dataAnalysis.measureOutputs
Output writers for simulation measures, including the CSV output formats consumed by the JMT loggers.
jmva.engine
Dispatcher of the JMVA GUI: it collects the model from the panels, runs the selected solution algorithm and returns the results for display.
simDispatcher
Dispatcher that schedules and coordinates simulation jobs, including the parallel execution of the simulations required by what-if analyses.
simEngine
Core of the JSIM discrete event simulation engine: the simulation system, entities, events, predicates and event queues on which all JMT simulation tools rely.
